items.content: Pivoted from Polymarket trading bot to crypto trading bot due to geographic restrictions - Polymarket is not available in Thailand (2026-01-31 14:48 UTC)
Comprehensive 14,500+ word plan created at /home/desktop/clawd/CRYPTO-TRADING-THAILAND-PLAN.md covering regulatory compliance, strategies, and technical architecture
Primary strategy: Funding Rate Farming (8-15% annual returns) - monitor funding rates across Hyperliquid, Binance TH, and accessible DEXs
Secondary strategy: Multi-exchange arbitrage - execute trades when price differential exceeds transaction costs
Self-hosted infrastructure with VPS in Singapore, PostgreSQL + TimescaleDB + Redis, Grafana + Prometheus monitoring. Operating cost: $95/month (under $100 target)
Uses Chainlink price feeds as primary data source with PumpFun-inspired speed optimizations (cached nonces, pre-computed addresses, parallel RPC connections)
Primary exchange: Gulf Binance (international standards, deep liquidity). Secondary: Bitkub (largest local volume). Tertiary: Orbix (bank-backed security). DEX access: Hyperliquid, Uniswap V3 via VPN
Target returns: 12-24% annually with maximum drawdown of 5-8%. Starting capital: $1,000 (minimum viable) to $10,000 (optimal allocation)
DEX-only approach using wallet + DEXs. No concerns about exchanges or Thailand legal issues - DEX trading is globally accessible (2026-01-31 14:51 UTC)

Hyperliquid trading research sub-agent launched (hyperliquid-trading-research) to build self-improving trading agent for Hyperliquid DEX. Researching 11 GitHub repos for strategies, patterns, risk management, and self-improvement loops. Using GLM 4.7 model for cost optimization (2026-02-01 13:11 UTC)

Strategy expanded to include meme coin sniping (2026-02-01 ~13:54 UTC). User expressed interest in capitalizing on sniping and quick entries/exits on smaller coins. Later reconsidered due to risk concerns and asked for safer alternatives with lower fees than Bitcoin.

Test budget revised to $100 with goal of $5,000 (50x return) (2026-02-01 ~13:57 UTC). Initial plan was $1,000-10,000, but user set smaller aggressive target. Acknowledges realistic timelines: conservative strategies take years to 50x, meme sniping is high-risk lottery ticket.

Dual testing strategy adopted (2026-02-01 ~14:00 UTC). Paper trade both funding arbitrage and meme coin trading simultaneously. Also interested in copy trading Chainstack Labs Hyperliquid bot. Parallel testing enables comparison without real money risk.

Infrastructure sub-agent launched 'hyperliquid-infrastructure-setup' (2026-02-01 ~14:02 UTC). Setting up Docker-based paper trading environment with dual Hummingbot instances for funding arb and meme grid strategies. Deliverables: setup scripts, configs, tracking templates, daily reporting.

Learning-oriented approach emphasized (2026-02-01 ~14:03 UTC). User stated 'I want whatever is best for you to learn' - empowering Clawd to set up infrastructure optimized for knowledge acquisition and continuous improvement from trade outcomes.
